comments.author: @PoffinScientist
comments.text:
It took me quite some time to grasp the concept of "AI agents", because the first thing that would pop into my mind was this kind of automation talked about in this video (and it is not).

The naming "AI agents", by the way, is oversimple and confusing so. It is when you promp a LLM and, in the background, it re-prompts itself automatically in order to improve the final reply. But it won't do tasks triggered by constant online scanning, like these "AI bots" in the video do. LLMs only reply 1 to 1 for every prompt in a chatbox, while these automate things for you online. Both are "agentic" in their own way, but they're two disparate tech concepts apart. So, learn that today if there's other dummies like myself out there!
